description:
As a registered user
  I want to log in
  So that I can see my scan history

elements.name: Correct credentials give a working token

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
I log in with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
the response status should be 200
I should receive an authentication token
that token should let me view my profile as "Alice"

elements.name: Email address is not case-sensitive at login

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
I log in with email "Alice@EXAMPLE.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
the response status should be 200

elements.name: Wrong credentials get the same vague error

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
I log in with email "alice@example.com" and password "WrongPass1"
the response status should be 401
the error message should be "Invalid email or password"
I should not receive an authentication token

elements.name: Wrong credentials get the same vague error

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
I log in with email "nobody@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
the response status should be 401
the error message should be "Invalid email or password"
I should not receive an authentication token

elements.name: A Gmail user with dots and a +tag can log back in

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
a registered user "Gina" with email "Gina.Smith+qa@gmail.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
I log in with email "Gina.Smith+qa@gmail.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
the response status should be 200

elements.name: A malformed JSON body gets a clean 400, not a stack trace

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
I send a truncated JSON body to the login endpoint
the response status should be 400
the response should not reveal a stack trace

elements.name: Protected pages refuse requests without a valid token

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
I request my profile with the token "not-a-real-token"
the response status should be 401
the error message should be "Invalid authorization token"

elements.name: Repeated failed logins are throttled

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
I fail to log in 5 times in a row
I log in with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
the response status should be 429
the error message should be "Too many login attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes."

name: User login

description:
As a website owner
  I want to create an account
  So that I can run security scans and keep my results

elements.name: A new visitor registers successfully

steps.name: I register as "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
the response status should be 201
I should receive an authentication token
the returned user should have the name "Alice" and email "alice@example.com"
the response should not contain a password

elements.name: The stored password is hashed, never plain text

steps.name: I register as "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
the account for "alice@example.com" should store a bcrypt hash instead of "Passw0rd1"

elements.name: An email address cannot be registered twice, in any letter case

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
I register as "Imposter" with email "ALICE@Example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "User already exists"

elements.name: Invalid registration details are rejected before reaching the database

steps.name: I register as "Alice" with email "pw7@example.com" and password "Passw0r"
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "Password must be at least 8 characters long"
no account should exist for "pw7@example.com"

elements.name: Invalid registration details are rejected before reaching the database

steps.name: I register as "Alice" with email "pwnum@example.com" and password "Password"
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "Password must contain at least one number"
no account should exist for "pwnum@example.com"

elements.name: Invalid registration details are rejected before reaching the database

steps.name: I register as "Alice" with email "pwnil@example.com" and password ""
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "Password is required"
no account should exist for "pwnil@example.com"

elements.name: Invalid registration details are rejected before reaching the database

steps.name: I register as "Alice" with email "not-an-email" and password "Passw0rd1"
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "Please provide a valid email address"
no account should exist for "not-an-email"

elements.name: Invalid registration details are rejected before reaching the database

steps.name: I register as "Alice" with email "a@b" and password "Passw0rd1"
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "Please provide a valid email address"
no account should exist for "a@b"

elements.name: Invalid registration details are rejected before reaching the database

steps.name: I register as "" with email "noname@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "Name is required"
no account should exist for "noname@example.com"

elements.name: The shortest allowed password (8 characters, one digit) is accepted

steps.name: I register as "Alice" with email "edge@example.com" and password "abcdefg1"
the response status should be 201

elements.name: A password sent as a number is rejected cleanly

steps.name: I register with a JSON body where the password is the number 12345678
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "Password must be text"

name: User registration

description:
As a logged-in user
  I want to review, annotate and delete my past scans
  So that I can track fixes over time, without anyone else seeing my results

elements.name: My history lists only my own scans, newest first

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
a registered user "Bob" with email "bob@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" has scanned the test website, saved as "alice-scan"
"Bob" has scanned the test website, saved as "bob-scan"
"Alice" has scanned the test website, saved as "alice-scan-2"
"Alice" opens the scan history
the response status should be 200
the history should list exactly "alice-scan-2, alice-scan" in that order

elements.name: I can add a note to my scan

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
a registered user "Bob" with email "bob@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" has scanned the test website, saved as "alice-scan"
"Bob" has scanned the test website, saved as "bob-scan"
"Alice" adds the note "Add a Content-Security-Policy header" to "alice-scan"
the response status should be 200
"alice-scan" should have the note "Add a Content-Security-Policy header"

elements.name: Note length limit (boundary value analysis)

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
a registered user "Bob" with email "bob@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" has scanned the test website, saved as "alice-scan"
"Bob" has scanned the test website, saved as "bob-scan"
"Alice" adds a note of 0 characters to "alice-scan"
the response status should be 200

elements.name: Note length limit (boundary value analysis)

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
a registered user "Bob" with email "bob@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" has scanned the test website, saved as "alice-scan"
"Bob" has scanned the test website, saved as "bob-scan"
"Alice" adds a note of 500 characters to "alice-scan"
the response status should be 200

elements.name: Note length limit (boundary value analysis)

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
a registered user "Bob" with email "bob@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" has scanned the test website, saved as "alice-scan"
"Bob" has scanned the test website, saved as "bob-scan"
"Alice" adds a note of 501 characters to "alice-scan"
the response status should be 400

elements.name: I can delete my scan and it is gone

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
a registered user "Bob" with email "bob@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" has scanned the test website, saved as "alice-scan"
"Bob" has scanned the test website, saved as "bob-scan"
"Alice" deletes "alice-scan"
the response status should be 200
"alice-scan" should no longer exist

elements.name: Another user's scan is invisible to me

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
a registered user "Bob" with email "bob@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" has scanned the test website, saved as "alice-scan"
"Bob" has scanned the test website, saved as "bob-scan"
"Alice" tries to view "bob-scan"
the response status should be 404
the error message should be "Scan result not found"
"bob-scan" should still exist without a note

elements.name: Another user's scan is invisible to me

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
a registered user "Bob" with email "bob@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" has scanned the test website, saved as "alice-scan"
"Bob" has scanned the test website, saved as "bob-scan"
"Alice" tries to add a note "bob-scan"
the response status should be 404
the error message should be "Scan result not found"
"bob-scan" should still exist without a note

elements.name: Another user's scan is invisible to me

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
a registered user "Bob" with email "bob@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" has scanned the test website, saved as "alice-scan"
"Bob" has scanned the test website, saved as "bob-scan"
"Alice" tries to delete "bob-scan"
the response status should be 404
the error message should be "Scan result not found"
"bob-scan" should still exist without a note

elements.name: A malformed scan ID is rejected

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
a registered user "Bob" with email "bob@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" has scanned the test website, saved as "alice-scan"
"Bob" has scanned the test website, saved as "bob-scan"
"Alice" tries to view "not-an-id"
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "Invalid scan ID"

name: Managing my scan history

description:
As a logged-in website owner
  I want to scan my website
  So that I can find and fix security weaknesses

elements.name: Scanning my own website produces a graded report

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" scans the test website with ownership confirmed
the response status should be 200
the report should have a grade from A to F and a score from 0 to 100
the report should be saved in the history of "Alice"

elements.name: The scanner detects each weakness of the test website

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" scans the test website with ownership confirmed
the report should include a "Missing Security Header" finding

elements.name: The scanner detects each weakness of the test website

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" scans the test website with ownership confirmed
the report should include a "No HTTPS" finding

elements.name: The scanner detects each weakness of the test website

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" scans the test website with ownership confirmed
the report should include a "Cookie Missing HttpOnly Flag" finding

elements.name: The scanner detects each weakness of the test website

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" scans the test website with ownership confirmed
the report should include a "Outdated / Vulnerable Library" finding

elements.name: Redirects are followed and the final address is reported

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" scans the test website path "/redirect" with ownership confirmed
the response status should be 200
the report should say it was redirected to the test website home page

elements.name: A scan needs the owner's permission

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" scans the test website without confirming ownership
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "You must confirm you own this website or have permission to scan it."

elements.name: Invalid target addresses are refused

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" scans the address "example.com" with ownership confirmed
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "Please provide a valid URL including http:// or https://"

elements.name: Invalid target addresses are refused

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
"Alice" scans the address "ftp://127.0.0.1/file" with ownership confirmed
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "URL must start with http:// or https://"

elements.name: Scanning requires being logged in

steps.name: a registered user "Alice" with email "alice@example.com" and password "Passw0rd1"
an anonymous visitor scans the test website
the response status should be 401

elements.name: In production, internal network targets are blocked (SSRF)

"Alice" scans the address "http://localhost:8080/" with ownership confirmed
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "Scanning localhost or internal hostnames is not allowed"

"Alice" scans the address "http://127.0.0.1/" with ownership confirmed
the response status should be 400
the error message should be "Scanning private or internal IP addresses is not allowed"
